lede.zh: 在 16 张 PPU ZW810E 上，对 GLM-5.2 W4A8 做真实长 prompt 递增、前缀缓存冷/热复用和容量配置检查。最长成功请求为 660,016 tokens；1M 在该配置下未能达到。
lede.en: GLM-5.2 W4A8 was tested on 16 PPU ZW810E accelerators with increasing real prompts, cold/warm prefix-cache reuse, and capacity configuration checks. The longest successful request was 660,016 tokens; 1M was not reached with this configuration.

snapshot.zh: 端到端 prompt 阶梯 · 前缀缓存 · 可用上下文边界
snapshot.en: End-to-end prompt staircase · prefix cache · usable context boundary

heading.zh: 长文档常驻场景受益于前缀缓存
heading.en: Prefix caching changes the economics of persistent long documents

intro.zh: 长输入冷态 TTFT 随 prompt 长度增长；重复提问且命中缓存后，660K 请求的 TTFT 从约 896 秒降至 1.71 秒。容量实测到 660,016 tokens，但这是边界探测，不等于可用安全余量。
intro.en: Cold TTFT increases with prompt length. With a cached repeated document, the 660K request’s TTFT falls from about 896 seconds to 1.71 seconds. Capacity was measured to 660,016 tokens, a boundary probe rather than a safe operating margin.

note.zh: 报告中阶梯每个长度仅 1 次；冷/热复用结论是当前固定文本和缓存策略下的观测。1M 未达到，且 96 GB PPU、DSA KV dtype 与当前软件栈限制共同约束可用长度。
note.en: Each staircase length was measured once. Cold/warm results apply to the fixed prompt and cache policy tested. 1M was not reached; the 96 GB PPU, DSA KV dtype support, and tested software stack constrain the usable length.

heading.en: End-to-end requests succeeded up to 660K tokens

intro.zh: 每档发送一条完整请求，prompt token 数取自服务端统计。这里报告实际请求耗时，不用 KV 池自报值替代端到端可用性。
intro.en: One complete request was sent at each length, and prompt token counts came from server-side usage. These are request timings, not KV-pool capacity estimates.

title.zh: 冷态长 prompt 端到端耗时
title.en: Cold end-to-end latency for long prompts

hint.zh: 每点 n=1；只作可达边界观察。
hint.en: n=1 per point; observed feasibility only.

notes.zh: 660,016 tokens 的最终边界确认成功；距离该配置估算的 KV 上限不足 2,000 tokens，不能当作稳定运行的安全值。
notes.en: The final boundary confirmation succeeded at 660,016 tokens, less than 2,000 tokens below the configuration’s estimated KV limit; it is not a safe sustained operating target.

heading.zh: 热前缀将重复长文档的 TTFT 降到秒级
heading.en: A warm prefix reduces repeated-document TTFT to seconds

intro.zh: 同一长文档仅改变末尾问题，先测冷请求，再重复提问并通过服务端 cached token 增量确认命中。
intro.en: The document stayed the same while the final question changed. A cold request was followed by repeated queries, with cache hits verified from server-side cached-token deltas.

hint.zh: 缓存已命中 token 数由服务端计数器确认。
hint.en: Cached-token hits were confirmed by server-side counters.

notes.zh: 缓存加速只作用于重复前缀的 prefill；长 KV 下 decode TPOT 仍高于短上下文。
notes.en: Cache reuse accelerates prefill for the repeated prefix; decode TPOT with a long KV remains higher than short-context TPOT.

heading.zh: 实测边界依赖 TP16 与显存利用率设置
heading.en: The measured boundary depends on TP16 and memory-fraction settings

intro.zh: 测试了 TP8 + DP attention 与多种 TP16 配置。容量数据说明不同配置下可分配的 token 池，不代表每种配置都经过完整性能验收。
intro.en: TP8 + DP attention and several TP16 configurations were checked. Capacity values describe token-pool allocation, not full performance qualification of every variant.

notes.zh: TP16 显存利用率从 0.85 调到 0.92 后，容量增加约 12%；更大的 chunked prefill 候选发生 OOM，不作为可用配置。
notes.en: Raising TP16 memory fraction from 0.85 to 0.92 increased configured capacity by about 12%; larger chunked-prefill candidates ran out of memory and are not treated as usable configurations.

methodIntro.zh: 长 prompt 阶梯使用服务端 prompt token 计数与客户端端到端耗时；缓存测试通过服务端 cached token 计数器验证。容量扫参与端到端请求测试分开呈现。
methodIntro.en: The long-prompt staircase uses server-side prompt-token counts and client-side end-to-end timings. Cache tests verify hits through the server cached-token counter. Capacity sweeps and end-to-end request tests are reported separately.

methodNotes.zh: 每个 context staircase 长度 n=1；缓存冷/热各取固定请求观测；不报告统计分位数，也不推断生产 SLO。报告页面不包含节点名、IP、磁盘路径或内部服务地址。
methodNotes.en: Each context-staircase length has n=1; cache cold/warm values are observations from fixed requests. No statistical percentiles or production SLO are inferred. Hostnames, IP addresses, storage paths, and internal service addresses are omitted.

methodNotes.zh: 测试确认 1M 在该 16 卡 PPU 与软件栈组合下不可达；该结论限定于本次硬件、DSA KV 格式支持和服务配置。
methodNotes.en: The test did not reach 1M with this 16-card PPU and software stack. This conclusion is limited to the measured hardware, DSA KV-format support, and serving configuration.
